subject: Hosted API commit uplift — coordination & ops checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@retailspark.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@retailspark.com>
Date: 2025-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Increase in monthly commit & burst headroom

Hi Maya,

Quick note from our side — usage across our recommendation engine has steadily climbed and we're regularly hitting the 500M token/month band you currently provide. We expect a 2–3x increase over the holiday window (Nov–Jan) and want to lock in higher committed capacity to avoid throttling.

Key asks:
- Increase hosted commit from 500M -> 1.5B tokens/month starting Nov 1.
- Preserve current per-token pricing for the initial 6 months if possible, or propose a blended rate.
- Guarantee soft-burst headroom of +30% for traffic spikes with clear throttling rules.

Can you send a proposed amendment and the operational checklist (routing, rate limits, SLO expectations) — procurement will need that for approvals.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Patel
Head of ML Platforms, RetailSpark
[jordan.patel@retailspark.com]
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@retailspark.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Procurement Team <procurement@retailspark.com>
Date: 2025-09-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increase in monthly commit & burst headroom

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — this is doable and we can put together a clean amendment + ops onboarding checklist. High-level proposal:

1) Commit change: 500M -> 1.5B tokens/month, 12-month term starting Nov 1.
2) Pricing: offer a 3-month price protection (same per-token rate) followed by a blended tier from months 4–12.
3) Burst: we can provide a 30% transient burst pocket for short spikes (90th percentile burst duration < 2 mins) and a failover to a compatible lower-cost model if sustained above burst.

Attachments I will share: hosted_commit_ratecard_v3.xlsx (rate table), ops_onboarding_checklist.docx (routing, quota gating, KV cache prewarm notes).

A few asks for procurement to speed review: preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly), PO contact, and whether a standard vendor addendum is required.

I'll loop in Ben and Karthik to confirm commercial flexibility and any SLA exceptions we should bake into the amendment.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[mobile: +1-415-555-0199]
[Attachment: hosted_commit_ratecard_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@retailspark.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@retailspark.com>
Date: 2025-09-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increase in monthly commit & burst headroom

Thanks Maya — procurement confirmed monthly billing and our PO contact is Elisa Hu (elisa.hu@retailspark.com). A couple of follow-ups from legal/procurement:

- Can you do a 6-month price protection instead of 3? Holiday traffic is uncertain and team wants stability.
- We need explicit language on soft-throttle behavior (how long before fallback to a cheaper variant, and whether KV-caches persist across fallbacks).
- Small ask: can you add a one-time onboarding credit to offset our migration runbook (~$2k estimate)?

If you can get that in a redline, we can fast-track approvals.

Cheers,
Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-09-22T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: RetailSpark concession options (pricing + onboarding credit)

Maya / Karthik — looping in my suggested concessions before I respond to Jordan. Summary:

- Extend price protection to 6 months (from 3) if they commit to the 12-month term for the 1.5B band.
- Grant a one-time onboarding credit of $2,000 (applied to the first invoice).
- Keep burst pocket at +30% transient, but tighten fallback policy: if sustained >30% for more than 10 minutes, route to the documented compatible variant and emit a routed-event to their webhook. KV-cache will be invalidated for that stream to avoid correctness risks; we'll provide warm-up scripts in the checklist.

Operational notes to include in the amendment/ops doc: routing policy name (retailspark-holiday-2025), contact escalation (oncall + phone), expected latency SLO at 95th percentile, and a 24/7 escalation window during Nov–Jan (optional add-on).

If that looks good I'll draft redline_contract_v2.pdf and send back to Maya to finalize.

—Ben
Head of Dedicated & Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@retailspark.com>, Elisa Hu <elisa.hu@retailspark.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Procurement Team <procurement@retailspark.com>
Date: 2025-09-23T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increase in monthly commit & burst headroom — revised amendment & next steps

Hi Jordan / Elisa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per our internal discussion we've prepared an updated amendment that addresses your items:

- 12-month commit at 1.5B tokens/month starting Nov 1.
- 6-month price protection on existing per-token rate, then a blended tier for months 7–12 (see hosted_commit_ratecard_v3.xlsx).
- One-time onboarding credit of $2,000 applied to the first invoice.
- Burst: +30% transient pocket. If sustained above burst for >10 minutes, automatic routing to compatible model variant with event webhook and KV-cache invalidation; warm-up scripts included.

Attached: redline_contract_v2.pdf (amendment with the above language) and ops_onboarding_checklist.docx. Please review and let me know if legal wants any additional language around rollback/fallback. If the wording is acceptable I'll send the DocuSign link for signature and provision the commit pool to start Nov 1.

Next steps:
1) Procurement confirms PO and signs DocuSign (I will send the link).
2) Ops runbook review with your infra lead (we can schedule a 45-minute session).
3) Provisioning on Nov 1 — we will prewarm cache starting Oct 25.

Thanks — I'll send DocuSign in the next message.

Best,
Maya
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_contract_v2.pdf (PDF)]

Jordan / Elisa —

DocuSign link for amendment: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123-hosted-commit

I've also attached the ops checklist and ratecard again for your procurement folder. Once signed we'll:
- Issue the onboarding credit on your first invoice.
- Begin prewarm steps on Oct 25 (ops will share runbook and calendar invite).
- Provision the 1.5B commit pool on Nov 1.

If you sign today we can hit all milestones comfortably. Let me know if you want the 45-minute ops runbook call scheduled earlier.

Thanks,
Maya
